review_findings: Mx101 is an anchor/foundation-context sheet with structural column evidence, but dense anchor, base-plate, dimension and reference graphics make per-instance column boundaries ambiguous without tight visual association.
Long/Prominent PDF vectors are not considered column or wall instances by themselves.
User-confirmed wall regions A-D and the two blue-marked regions are preserved as separate wall-semantic QA; E-F remain no-wall. None of this approves column boxes.
No detector box is promoted when the visible source-graphic instance cannot be separated from nearby anchor/dimension/detail graphics without speculation.
